date:artaxerxes-sends-nehemiah-to-jerusa.note: Neh 2:1 gives only Artaxerxes' twentieth year, in Nisan. The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:construction-of-the-second-temple@9.note: Ezra 3:8 dates the start to the second year after the return; 6:15 dates the finish to Darius's sixth year. BC years depend on outside dating.

date:exiles-put-away-their-foreign-wives.note: Ezra 10:9 gives the ninth month and day, not the year; the year follows from Ezra 7:7 (seventh year of Artaxerxes). BC year depends on outside dating.

date:exiles-return-with-zerubbabel@6fb45.note: Ezra 1:1 dates the decree to Cyrus's first year. The BC year depends on outside chronology.

date:ezra-leads-exiles-to-jerusalem@ecd1.note: Ezra 7:7-8 dates the journey to Artaxerxes' seventh year, arriving in the fifth month. The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:nehemiah-arrives-at-jerusalem@7a4e9.note: Neh 2:1 gives Artaxerxes' twentieth year; 2:11 has Nehemiah's arrival. The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:nehemiah-goes-back-to-artaxerxes@37.note: Neh 13:6 gives Artaxerxes' thirty-second year. The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:nehemiah-mourns-for-jerusalem@b52fd.note: Neh 1:1 gives Chisleu of the twentieth year without naming the king; 2:1 identifies it as Artaxerxes'. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:nehemiah-rebuilds-the-wall-of-jerus.note: Neh 2:1 gives Artaxerxes' twentieth year; 6:15 gives the 52 days to finish. The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-artaxerxes@c41586.note: Neh 5:14 and 13:6 give Artaxerxes' twentieth through thirty-second years. The span's BC dates depend on outside chronology.

date:reign-of-darius-ahasuerus@06d528.note: Ezra 4:24 and 6:15 give Darius's second and sixth years. The span and the Ahasuerus label rest on outside identification; Ezra 4:6 lists Ahasuerus after Darius.

date:return-from-exile@3e6647.note: Ezra 1:1 starts the return in Cyrus's first year. The text gives no end date for the return; Neh 13:6 is only a later year. BC years depend on outside dating.

date:second-temple-dedicated@3585fa.note: Ezra 6:15 finishes the house on Adar 3 in Darius's sixth year; 6:16 has the dedication. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:temple-work-is-stopped@c18da0.note: Ezra 4:5 and 4:24 say the work ceased until Darius's second year; no start year is given. The BC year depends on outside dating.

date:temple-work-resumes@9ebaf0.note: Haggai 1:1 and 1:15 date the restart to Darius's second year, sixth month. Ezra 5:1-2 gives no year. The BC year depends on outside dating.

occurred-at:artaxerxes-sends-nehemiah-to.note: Neh 1:1 places Nehemiah at Shushan the palace; the sending in 2:1-8 follows in the king's court, the same scene.

occurred-at:exiles-put-away-their-foreig.note: Ezra 10:9 gathers the men unto Jerusalem, sitting in the street of the house of God. The matched verse, 9:9, names no place for this event.

occurred-at:exiles-return-with-zerubbabe.note: Ezra 1:11: they were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem. Babylon is only the starting point; the return ends at Jerusalem.
Ezra 1:11 brings them up unto Jerusalem; 2:1 says they came again unto Jerusalem and Judah. The matched 1:5 only states their aim.

occurred-at:ezra-leads-exiles-to-jerusal.note: Ahava was one camp on the way, where Ezra gathered them and fasted. The journey began at Babylon and ended at Jerusalem (8:32).
Ezra 7:6 and 7:9: he went up from Babylon, where the journey began. Babylon is the point of departure; the leading ends at Jerusalem.

occurred-at:nehemiah-goes-back-to-artaxe.note: Neh 13:6 calls Artaxerxes 'king of Babylon' but does not name where the audience took place. Nehemiah served at Shushan (1:1), so Babylon rests on the title.
Neh 13:6 has Nehemiah come unto the king; 13:7 has him come to Jerusalem only afterward. The audience was not at Jerusalem.

occurred-at:nehemiah-mourns-for-jerusale.note: Neh 1:1 places Nehemiah in Shushan the palace; 1:4 has him sit down, weep and mourn after Hanani's report.

occurred-at:reign-of-artaxerxes>susa_111.note: A reign has no single location. Neh 1:1 and 2:1 place Artaxerxes' court at Shushan in his twentieth year; no verse places the whole reign there.

occurred-at:temple-work-is-stopped>jerus.note: Ezra 4:23: the enemies went up in haste to Jerusalem and made the Jews cease by force; 4:24: the work of the house at Jerusalem ceased.

occurred-at:temple-work-resumes>jerusale.note: Ezra 5:2: Zerubbabel and Jeshua began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem. The matched 5:1 only names the prophets' audience.

participated-in:artaxerxes_313>temple-wo.note: The king's letter stops the work (4:21, 4:23). Whether record 313 is the Artaxerxes of Ezra 7 and Nehemiah 2 (314) is outside identification; check for a duplicate.

participated-in:artaxerxes_314>artaxerxe.note: The king sends Nehemiah: 'So it pleased the king to send me' (2:6). The matched 2:1 only sets the date.

participated-in:artaxerxes_314>ezra-lead.note: The king grants Ezra all his request (7:6) and decrees that the willing people go up with him (7:13).

participated-in:darius_978>reign-of-dari.note: Ezra 4:24 names Darius's reign, so he takes part. The label 'Ahasuerus' is an outside identification; Ezra 4:6 lists Ahasuerus after Darius.

participated-in:eliashib_1101>nehemiah-g.note: In the event's own verses (13:4-7), Eliashib gives Tobiah a temple chamber while Nehemiah is away. He acts in the episode, not in the trip to the king.

participated-in:ezra_1245>ezra-leads-exi.note: Ezra 7:6: 'This Ezra went up from Babylon', leading the company. The matched 7:1 only gives his genealogy.

participated-in:geshem_1307>nehemiah-reb.note: Geshem joins Sanballat in sending for Nehemiah to a meeting meant as mischief (6:2). The matched 6:1 only says he heard of the wall.

participated-in:nehemiah_2172>artaxerxes.note: Nehemiah asks the king to send him to Judah (2:5), and the king sends him (2:6).

participated-in:nehemiah_2172>nehemiah-a.note: 'So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days' (2:11), in Nehemiah's own account.

participated-in:nehemiah_2172>nehemiah-g.note: 'I came unto the king' (13:6): Nehemiah makes the return visit to Artaxerxes.

participated-in:nehemiah_2172>nehemiah-m.note: 'I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed' (1:4). The matched 1:1 only gives his name.

participated-in:nehemiah_2172>nehemiah-r.note: Nehemiah son of Hachaliah leads the rebuilding (2:17-18). The matched 3:16 is Nehemiah son of Azbuk, another man repairing part of Bethzur.

participated-in:tobiah_2872>nehemiah-goe.note: In the event's own verses (13:4-7), Tobiah is given a temple chamber while Nehemiah is away. He is the one it's done for, not part of the trip to the king.

participated-in:zerubbabel_3054>exiles-r.note: Ezra 2:2: the people came 'with Zerubbabel', who leads the return. The matched 1:8 names Sheshbazzar; linking him to Zerubbabel is outside identification.

participated-in:darius_978>second-temple.note: Darius's decree (6:12) is earlier and he is only named as an authority in 6:14. The dedication (6:16-22) does not show him acting.

participated-in:darius_978>temple-work-r.note: Darius makes the decree and orders the records searched (6:1). That falls inside this event's range (5:1-6:12).

participated-in:sanballat_2470>nehemiah-.note: Sanballat laughs at the building plan and despises the builders (2:19), inside this event's range (2:9-20).

participated-in:tobiah_2872>nehemiah-arr.note: Tobiah laughs at the plan and despises the builders (2:19), inside this event's range (2:9-20). Verse 2:10 shows only his grief.
